Nice Place but...
Aug 2026 • Family
Nice place but, the incompetent chef with a real insult to Italian cuisine, proposes Carbonara made with liquid cream and mushrooms... Remove Carbonara from the menu and the chef from the kitchen
Written August 29, 2026
Le Cercle Sportif Hue
Dear E6183NUmarcob,

Thank you for taking the time to share your feedback with us. We are pleased that you enjoyed the setting at Le Cercle, and we are sorry that the Carbonara did not meet your expectations.

We appreciate your comment regarding the preparation of the dish. Our Carbonara is intended as a contemporary interpretation, with wild mushrooms added to bring an additional earthy character to the dish. That said, we fully understand your point regarding the use of cream, particularly for guests familiar with the traditional Italian preparation.

We have shared your feedback with our Chef and culinary team and will review the recipe to ensure that the dish maintains a clear Carbonara character while remaining true to Le Cercle's contemporary approach.

Thank you again for your constructive feedback. It is valuable to us and helps us continually improve.

Warm regards,
Le Cercle Management Team
